steps.content: The man in the golden mask who'd harassed her earlier is closing in again. Sallie tries to dodge, but he seizes her hand with a cold, disgruntled snort.

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: You should be grateful I even glanced your way. You've no curves to speak of, no manners. Heh! Know your place.

steps.speaker: Young Guest
steps.content: Haha, exactly! Mr. Owl, what do you even see in her?

steps.speaker: Short Guest
steps.content: The chick isn't the prettiest girl here, nor the most entertaining. She's... <color=#fb9259>not even a Sinner</color>.
The short guest peers at Sallie through the curve of his wine glass.

steps.speaker: Short Guest
steps.content: Ahhh... Haha, I get it now! She's the dimwit, isn't she? The one who tripped on stage!
He bursts into laughter, slapping Mr. Owl on the shoulder. The young guest on the other side joins in, smirking with a suggestive look.

steps.speaker: Young Guest
steps.content: Well, congratulations, newbie. Starting things off with a bang! I wish you both... a lovely evening, hahaha.

The man in the golden mask lets out a cold sneer. He tugs at the collar of his suit with both hands, straightening it. It's hard to tell whether he's pleased or offended. He rises to his feet and turns his gaze on Sallie, deliberately looking down on her.

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: This isn't an invitation. It's an opportunity for you to serve me. Do you understand?
The other guests, well aware of what he means, wolf whistle and look on.
The young guest picks up a glass of wine and tries to shove it into Sallie's hand. She forces a smile and pushes it back.

steps.speaker: Young Guest
steps.content: Heh, putting on airs before you've even made it big?

steps.speaker: Young Guest
steps.content: Think about it. Once you're with Mr. Owl, you'll have anything you could ever dream of. Besides, you're a dancer... isn't this what you do for a living?
His voice hardens as he pushes the glass toward her again. Wine spills over Sallie's hand in the back-and-forth. She flinches, and in that instant, the taut string inside her snaps.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: I... don't want to.
Her voice is quiet, but the air freezes. The dancers nestled in the other guests' arms gasp, hands covering their mouths, shocked that she would refuse.
The guests in their animal masks seem to have united in purpose. They set down their drinks, their eyes turning cold behind the masks, piercing Sallie like frozen daggers.

steps.speaker: Short Guest
steps.content: Mr. Owl, seems like the chick doesn't understand the rules here.

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: Hmph... I figured as much. But I like her fighting spirit. The look in her eyes... I like that.

Sallie feels uncomfortable under their gaze, her skin crawling as every hair stands on end. She had imagined the consequences of refusal, but reality proves more ruthless than anything she could imagine.
Cassian watches the scene. His eyes meet Sallie's across the room before he looks down, continuing to polish a glass. He seems to give a faint shake of his head.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: The guests here get whatever they want. As long as they want it.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: Farewell. May you find peace in hell.
She's too far away to hear him, but just by reading his lips, she can feel the chill behind the words.

Back as a dancer in Eastside, she thought she'd learned how to handle lecherous guests. But a suffocating dread, something beyond her experience, now seizes her, making her blood run cold. Like a fledgling bird with its head held high, she plummets into a lawless abyss.
All the masks turn to her, their dark eyeholes boring into her soul. She hears snickering. She wants to run, to scream. And at that moment...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Oh my, if it isn't Mr. Merlot!
A familiar sweet fragrance fills Sallie's nose as a flash of gold bobs into her view.
Milly bounds into the space between Sallie and Merlot, a delighted look on her face. She cheerfully loops her arm through the man's, while pressing down the hand he was reaching toward Sallie.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: You've been here so many times but never requested me or any of the other girls. And now you're suddenly taken with Sallie... don't tell me it's love at first sight? Oh my, that's so romantic!
While Mr. Merlot is still confused, another figure slides in from the other side.

steps.speaker: Magician
steps.content: Mr. Merlot, didn't you say just last night how fascinating my magic tricks were? Now you're picking the new girl! What happened to first-come, first-served? You're making me jealous.
The magician nudges the stunned Sallie aside, playfully taking the man's other arm and pulling it toward herself.

The man tries to look back, but he can't resist the two beautiful women fawning over him, or the wolf whistles from the other guests. Feeling quite flattered, he's coaxed away within moments, leaving Sallie standing there, her face ashen.
Not daring to dwell on what happened, Sallie flees amid the chaos.
